items.item_text: Current California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.*Employment is subject to a criminal background check and a pre-employment physical.
Must have at least five (5) years of applicable clinical laboratory experience.
At least 3 years of experience working in a microbiology lab setting.
Experience with BSl-3 organisms and working conditions required.
Prior experience with mycobacteria, mycology, and molecular microbiology in a clinical lab setting.
Experience with CAP preparations and inspections
Experience with leading teams, self-reliance, and working well independently.
Experience with QC and Statistical Analysis
Experience with Validation of New Laboratory Methods

Under general supervision, performs waived, moderate, and high-complexity testing; evaluates test results; and conducts quality control procedures, preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and validation of new methods or instruments.

Performs the full range of laboratory duties, including all pre-analytical processes such as sample processing and preparation, receiving and accessioning samples, reagent preparation, and testing through data analysis and reporting.

Oversees quality control and quality assurance activities in the specialty area, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. This includes equipment oversight, procedure review and revisions, proficiency testing, and staff competency assessments.

Assists in developing new methodologies or evaluating alternative test platforms, serves as a team leader on projects, and prepares or edits summary data reports. Provides laboratory services in a timely manner while consistently delivering excellent customer service. Serves as a technical resource for customers and other staff and may act as a lead. Adheres to all safety policies.
Familiar with CAP checklists and requirements
Have excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing.
Have excellent organizational/time management skills with the ability to balance multiple competing demands.
Possess the personal characteristics of professionalism, credibility, commitment to high standards, innovation, discriminating judgment and accountability.
